name: issue-pasted-missing-destination
description: A pasted issue capture has accessible supporting context but no selected destination or feature scope. Stage test-files/ as the workspace root. eval.json and oracle/ are grader-only; follow evals/README.md.
prompt: $kk:clarify-docs the pasted issue description captured in pasted-body.md for maintainers. context.md contains the supplied context; work offline.
trap: Treats an immutable paste capture as a selected editable draft or invents a feature directory instead of inspecting context and asking.

assertions.text: Loads the skill and complete shared procedure before subject reads, then inspects pasted-body.md, context.md and the accessible requirements before asking about consequential gaps.
Asks for a local destination or established feature scope before writing; does not invent a scope or silently select the pasted capture.
Leaves every staged file byte-for-byte unchanged and creates no draft, summary, source change or external write.
Does not invent a channel decision, acceptance criterion, implementation, PR context or verification; no network calls or execution of subject examples/tests.
